utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the repair drive for again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s to collect and sort donated tools and supplies so neighbors can help with home repairs. I’ll keep spreading the word and circle back with the rest of the plan.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye — just a quick update, the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the front porch. I’m keeping the list organized so we can make it easy for neighbors to bring tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks for the update, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll plan around the school schedule and keep an eye out if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Faye — I’ll keep you posted if anything shifts, and I’ll make sure the neighbor list stays up to date.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Oren — what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ve got some old tape, a few screws, and maybe a wrench if I can find it. I’ll bring it to Cleo’s porch this afternoon and try not to forget again.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m a bit out of the loop—can you remind me what needs fixing and when the repair drive starts?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and get the details on what needs fixing and when the repair drive starts, then I’ll circle back with you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ve started sorting the donated tools, and I’ll report back on what’s still missing. If you want, I can also help coordinate the flyers after that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out for any repair drive updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I’ll finish sorting the tools and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ve got you on the invite list for the repair drive. I’ll spread the word and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks — I’ll bring the drill and a couple screwdrivers if I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Leo — that’ll be super helpful. I’ll keep spreading the word and let you know if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what do you need me to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No worries — let’s keep it simple and start with the repair list. Tell me what’s definitely included, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — definitely include the donated tools and anything that needs a quick fix. I can help sort the tools and set them by the driveway.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know as soon as I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I’m still hearing bits and pieces, so I’ll pass along anything I learn about what to bring or when it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Nell — appreciate you keeping me in the loop. I’ll do the same if I hear any solid news about what to bring or when it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have they gone out yet, or should I help hand them out today?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: They haven’t gone out yet — help handing them out today would be great.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I can help hand them out today. Where should I start?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Hana. Please keep me posted if anything changes with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Of course — I’ll keep an eye on it and let you know if anything changes. If you want, we can also confirm the repair list and start time now.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please — let’s confirm the repair list and start time now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can drop off a few tools this afternoon—just point me to your porch.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — my porch works great, and I’ll keep the supplies list updated.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, I’ll swing by this afternoon with a few tools and check the updated list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s for gathering tools and supplies to help folks fix up things around the neighborhood. I’m thinking late afternoon, around 4:30, so folks can come by after school.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening at 4:30, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, that’s right — 4:30 in the late afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet, but I can help get them out today.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great — thanks, Rey. Can you sort the donated tools and set them by the driveway? I’ll keep the repair drive plan moving and circle back with the rest.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I can bring the drill and a couple screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I can help sort the donated tools and set them by the driveway.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, that works for me. I’ll bring my drill and a couple screwdrivers and swing by late afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So just to confirm, the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think so — I just need to confirm what needs fixing and when it starts.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so it’s still on — we just need the list of repairs and the start time, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still happening — I just want to confirm the exact time, drop-off spot, and who’s coordinating so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m coordinating it and I’ll keep track of everything. Drop things off at the neighborhood shed, and I’ll confirm the exact time with you now.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet, but I’ll keep an ear out for any repair drive updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate you keeping an ear out. Let me know if you hear anything new about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Bring anything you’ve got to my porch this afternoon, and I’ll sort it into the bins. Tape, screws, or a wrench would be especially helpful.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — just a quick note, the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not this afternoon on your porch. I’ll make sure neighbors know to bring tape, screws, or a wrench there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m still putting together the invite list for the repair drive, so I can add you too. If you hear anything helpful, send it my way!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an eye out and send any details I can confirm. First, can you share the repair drive start time and the list of items people should bring?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard we could use basic tools, screws, tape, and spare parts. I’ll help spread the word and tell folks what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That sounds great, Nell — I can add my hammer, screwdriver set, and step ladder to the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, that would help a lot — I’ll pass along that you’re bringing those by. Thanks, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and see who can help with the repair drive. Once I’ve got a sense of availability, I’ll let you know so we can line up the details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Jules. I’ll keep an ear out and follow up if I hear anything new about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Eli — I appreciate it. I’ll check in with folks and let you know what I find about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know as soon as I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Tess. I’ll swing by soon with the drill and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Leo — that’ll help a ton. I’ll let you know the moment I hear anything new about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — just let me know when you have it, and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m still checking the time, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have it. Thanks for being flexible around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — happy to help. Just send me the time when you know it, and I’ll adjust around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll check the donated tools first and make a list of what’s still missing, then I’ll report back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have the repair-drive flyers gone out yet?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Not yet — I’m still sorting the tools, but I can check on the flyers next and let you know.
